question:
The volume of a solid cylinder is 34,650 cm³ . If the height is 25 cm, then the circumference of the base is:

(Use pi = (22)/(7) )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of cylinder = Base Area × Height

⇒ Base Area = 34650 ÷ 25 = 1386 cm²

⇒ πr² = 1386 ⇒ (22/7) × r² = 1386 ⇒ r² = 441 ⇒ r = 21 cm

Circumference of base = 2πr = 2 × (22/7) × 21 = 132 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 132 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of the solid cylinder (V) = 34,650 cm³

Height of the cylinder (h) = 25 cm

Value of π = 22/7

 Volume = 34,650 cm³

• h = 25 cm 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

Circumference of the circular base = 2πr

**Calculations:**

⇒ πr²h = 34650

⇒ (22/7) × r² × 25 = 34650

⇒ r² = (34650 × 7) ÷ (22 × 25)

⇒ r² = (34650 × 7) ÷ 550

⇒ r² = 63 × 7

⇒ r² = 441

⇒ r = √441 = 21 cm

Now, substitute the value of radius (r) to find the circumference of the base:

⇒ Circumference = 2πr

⇒ Circumference = 2 × (22/7) × 21

⇒ Circumference = 2 × 22 × 3

⇒ Circumference = 132 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 132 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a Cylinder

It represents the area of the curved surface excluding the flat top and bottom bases. Formula: CSA = 2πrh

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cylinder

It includes the curved surface area along with the areas of the two circular bases. Formula: TSA = 2πr(r + h)

Volume of a Cone

A cone with the same base radius and height as a cylinder will have exactly one-third of the cylinder's volume. Formula: Volume = (1/3)πr²h
